name: E-Teller Bank Mini API
source_of_truth: Laravel backend implementation (routes, form requests, controllers, services, resources). This file is a generated index; see docs/API.md for examples.

conventions.paginated_list: {data: [...], links: {first,last,prev,next}, meta: {current_page, from, last_page, links, path, per_page, to, total}}
conventions.sorting: no sort parameters; fixed order per endpoint

errors.401: {message:'Unauthenticated.'} missing/invalid/expired token; {message, code:'firebase_token_invalid'} invalid, expired, revoked or disabled Firebase ID token
errors.403: {message} wrong actor/role, blocked staff, closed customer, or admin account protection; customer auth: {message, code} with code account_not_linked | account_inactive | email_not_verified | activation_mismatch | provider_not_allowed | identity_mismatch
errors.404: {message:'Data tidak ditemukan.'} not found or not owned
errors.409: {message} staff delete refused (has history); {message, code} identity_already_linked | already_activated | pin_already_set
errors.422: {message, errors?} validation (errors per field) or business rule (message only, sometimes extra fields); {message, code} pin_not_set | customer_app_not_activated
errors.500: {message} server error; money operations fully rolled back
errors.503: {message, code:'auth_unavailable'} Firebase unreachable or not configured

auth.login: POST /api/login (staff: username+password; customer: id_token = Firebase ID token). NIS/account number + PIN is not a credential
auth.customer_identity: Firebase Authentication (Google or email/password), bound to the account at first-time activation (POST /api/customer/activation with the NIS; the verified email must equal the registered email). The customer then creates the 6-digit PIN (POST /api/customer/pin/setup), which unlocks the app during a session and authorizes withdrawals. The backend sends no email

endpoints.purpose: Customer login: verify a Firebase ID token (Google or email/password) and start a customer session.

endpoints.response: 200 {data:{actor:'customer', token, token_type:'Bearer', expires_at, customer: Customer {id, account_number, nis, full_name, email, activation_status, activated_at, pin_set, class, group, major{id,code,major_name}, account_status, balance, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at}}}
errors: 401 firebase_token_invalid (bad signature, expired, wrong project, revoked, disabled or deleted Firebase user)
403 account_not_linked (no activated account for this Firebase UID; accounts are never matched by email)
endpoints.notes: The customer is found by the verified token's UID only. Revocation and disabled status are checked with Firebase on every call. Suspended accounts may log in. The session lasts CUSTOMER_SESSION_MINUTES (default 30 days).

endpoints.purpose: Ask for a forgotten-PIN reset. Pending until an administrator approves; the new PIN can be set only after available_at (24 hours later, config bank.pin_reset_wait_hours). The customer's phones get a push. While a request is open, withdrawals on the account are paused.
rate_limit: 5 per minute per customer (unlock and PIN setup)

id_token.rules: fresh Firebase ID token of the account bound to this customer, max 4096
